Topuria's nine-part essay on his loss; new detail is that he suffered two orbital fractures, a broken septum and a broken foot. That revelation is the fact, but the piece is mostly reflection, so no_fact or personal_life is defensible. He says he does not know what his next fight will look like.
Card-wide UFC Paris predictions; the writer picks Soriano over Donchenko. The fight is set for Saturday, so next_fight, but as a prediction piece no_fact is also reasonable.
Topuria's Instagram words on the loss making him hungrier; he says he does not know when or where he fights next. Outlet's mention of fans predicting Pimblett in December is speculation.

Physical trainer Jesus Gallo says Topuria would be physically ready before end of 2026 but the team prefers to wait to 2027; Merab Dvalishvili adds he is well. Return timing is the headline, so his_team and next_fight, but Merab (other_fighter) and health (fractures healing) are equally present, and Gallo's 'should wait' is also steers_him.

Joe Rogan warns Topuria to be careful not to come back too soon; Topuria's Instagram quote on getting back up is included. Rogan's remark is advice on what he should do, but it is also an assessment of his recovery.

Post-fight interview: Donchenko wants Daniel Rodriguez next, ideally at year end or a five-rounder at the APEX, and explains the third-round takedown; his unanimous-decision win over Soriano is reported. The callout is a wish, so next-fight no; the article is as much about the wish as the result.
